<%
    	String userId = session.getAttribute("SSO_ID")==null ? "" : session.getAttribute("SSO_ID").toString().toUpperCase();
    %>
        <script type="text/javascript" src="<%=CONTEXT_NAME%>/resource/plugin/sepoasoft/login/login.js"></script>
        <script type="text/javascript">
            Sepoa.cache.text.load([{
                url:CONTEXT_NAME+'/resource/ux/admin/langs/'+(Sepoa.request.LANGAUGE || 'KO')+'/POA_BASE.js'
            }]);

            function SepoaSSO(config){
                sUtils.modules.extend(this, "EventManager");
                sUtils.modules.extend(this, SepoaIndex.prototype.login);
                this.$var = {};
                this.config = $.extend(true, {}, config);
                this.send = function(){
                    var config = {
                        progress:true,
                        nickName:"sepoa.svc.login.cbo_012.LoginSSO",
                        conType:"CONNECTION",
                        methodName:this.config.service,
                        requestMode:"doServiceAjax",
                        callback:function(so){
                            var shareObj = {};
                            this.callEvent('onLoginEnd', [so]);
                        }.bind(this)
                    }
                    var data = {};
                    data[Sepoa.common.KEY_PARAMS]= sUtils.url.toSepoaParams($.extend(this.config.sendParams||{},{
                        ID:"<%=userId%>"
                    }),false);
                    sUtils.connector.service(config, data);
                }
            }
        </script>
